method.scene: Synthetic five-customer rendering fixture; five orders and glasses, three cooking dosas and a carried plate; fixed customer body pose with anger effect; continuous pointer and clock.
method.viewport: 1480 x 1000 CSS, DPR 2 emulation, normally 2200 x 1600 canvas; density variants keep CSS size.
method.timing: 18 seconds cold preparation, then 12 seconds measured; full baselines bracket each matrix.
method.coldLongGaps: Sum of entire rAF gaps above 50 ms during preparation, not excess over ideal frame time and not additive CPU/GPU attribution.
method.fps: rAF draw opportunities per elapsed second, not physical scanout or unique authored poses.
method.cpu: Approximate matching browser-process CPU time across loading, preparation and measurement; 100% is one core. Newly created or departed processes may be omitted.
method.memory: Managed graphics backing accounting is separate from decoded audio and process PSS. None measures physical VRAM. PSS is readable process sum sampled after case, not peak game-only RAM.
method.audio: Same two decoded sources, actual AudioContext suspended versus running; same decoded memory.
method.controls: Same diagnostic wrappers on baseline and variants; fresh page and renderer per case. Full scene omissions are diagnostic, not recommended playable states.

limits: Synthetic scene does not rank every customer animation or full gameplay simulation.
Different software stacks do not isolate a single driver/browser cause.
Small changes within baseline variation are inconclusive.
Individual omission gains cannot be added.
No physical GPU execution, scanout, touch or audible playback certification.
Visual alternatives need visual acceptance and production regression tests before shipping.
